summary: Implements a header account dropdown, dialogs for change photo/password/delete account, adds i18n keys, adds optional `photo` field to `UserProfile`, and adds React Query mutations. However, several acceptance criteria and backend endpoints/data-deletion scope are not evidenced in the diff, and there are multiple unrelated changes/features added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Include at least 2 additional useful account actions beyond the required three, with labels translated via i18n.
missing_requirements.reason: Dropdown includes the three required items plus only one additional action ("View transparency & policies"); other suggested/required additional actions like Edit profile / Manage phone number / Logout are not present as menu items.

missing_requirements.requirement: Support clearing/removing the profile photo by saving a null/removed state so the header falls back to initials/avatar placeholder.
missing_requirements.reason: The remove flow appears to upload an empty blob (`ExternalBlob.fromBytes(new Uint8Array(0))`) rather than persisting `null`/absence; diff does not show backend logic interpreting this as removal, so persistence of 'no photo' state is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend method deletes the caller’s account and all associated stored records (links, schedules, filters, activities, locations, audit logs, disabled flags, etc.).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls `actor.deleteCallerAccount()`, but the diff summary for `backend/main.mo` is truncated before any `deleteCallerAccount` implementation and does not evidence deletion of the full set of associated records.

missing_requirements.requirement: Persist profile photo end-to-end (backend method to save photo) and have the header show it without refresh.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls `actor.saveProfilePhoto(blob)` and invalidates `currentUserProfile`, but the diff summary for `backend/main.mo` is truncated and does not show any `saveProfilePhoto` method or storage/persistence logic for the uploaded photo.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduces a "New Strict Admin Password" with a hardcoded value in the backend actor state.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly focuses on account dropdown actions and forbids third-party auth/password storage; adding an app-level admin password is not requested and is unrelated to the dropdown requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: Adds/changes multiple unrelated frontend behaviors (automatic polling/real-time-ish updates across parent/child views, pairing code clipboard behavior, admin panel layout changes).
hallucinated_features.reason: Non-goals include real-time menu updates, and the BuildRequest does not request broader dashboard polling or admin panel changes.
